folds.text: A **token** is a small piece of text, often a word or part of a word. Claude reads and writes in tokens.
Your message, Claude's reply and any files it reads all count as tokens. Usage limits are counted in them too.
The **context window** is Claude's desk for one chat. Everything in the chat has to fit on it, and Claude re-reads it all with each message.
When the desk is full, older parts get squeezed into a summary. Details can get lost, so restate anything important or start a fresh chat.

folds.prompt: Drag to fill Claude's desk and watch what happens.

stages.text: Plenty of room. Claude can see the whole chat.
Getting crowded. Each message now carries a lot of old chat along.
Full! Older parts get squeezed into a summary and small details may be lost.
